newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Tel rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Tel rated a buy.

text.p: UBS Ltd has rated Israel's Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd a buy in a report released on Wednesday, saying the company should begin rapid growth in the second half of 1997.

"By the second half, strong, positive year-on-year earnings growth should return, which will serve to highlight the company's glaringly inexpensive valuation of only nine to 10 times next year's earnings," said analyst Daniel Carasso.
"For investors willing to wait one to two quarters for superior long-term share performance, we rate the stock a buy," he said.
UBS said Tadiran Tel, a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd, was making a successful transition from its reliance on sales to Bezeq Israel Telecom, Israel's main telecommunications company, to exports.

"The climb out of the fourth-quarter...Bezeq trough is clearly observable," Carasso said. He noted that exports accounted for 54 percent of Tadiran Tel sales in the first quarter, up from less than a third a year ago.
Carasso nevertheless said he reduced Tadiran Tel's forecasted earnings by $0.15 in each of the next three years to $1.60 per share in 1997, $1.90 in 1998 and $2.25 in 1999.
